Unique Research · Company / Funding · May 26, 2022

On May 25, 2022, connected CRM vendor Fenxiang Xiaoke (纷享销客) (founded 2011) closed a ¥100M strategic from Chinasoft International — 12th round — to co-build sales, delivery, and channel for mid/large enterprises. Open enterprise messaging base connecting people, business, customers; CRM + PRM + SCRM for full lifecycle sales/marketing/service across WeChat ecosystem.

— END —
